verify_detail: nt is not durable across the most common real-world lifecycle event (process death). This isn't a cosmetic issue; it defeats the app's core purpose. Everything else I could exercise (tap handling, concurrency, rendering, background/foreground transitions without process death) worked correctly, so the fix is narrow: persist the counter (e.g., `SharedPreferences`/`DataStore`, written on each increment or in `onStop`) and restore it on launch. I'd block release until that's fixed and re-verified."
